landing.tagline: Every conversation leaves a trace. We read it.
landing.feature1desc: See how the tone shifted month by month.
landing.feature2desc: The gaps tell a story too.
landing.feature3desc: A written interpretation in plain language.
landing.privacyNote: Your messages are never stored. Processing is ephemeral.
landing.block1desc: See how the tone of a conversation shifted month by month. Warmth. Distance. Silence.
landing.block2desc: The gaps between messages tell a story too. LASTSEEN reads what wasn't said.
landing.block3desc: A written interpretation in plain language. Not a summary — a story about two people.
landing.step1: Export your WhatsApp chat without media. Just the .txt file.
landing.step2: Upload it. The system parses every message, calculates patterns, and runs the analysis.
landing.step3: See the story. In chapters. Without the cold.
landing.seen1desc: Corrected initiative balance — not who messaged first, but who broke the silence when the other person wouldn't. Plus double text tracking: who followed up unanswered.
landing.seen2desc: Response decay over time. A score from 0 to 1. A turning point date. A trend.
landing.seen3desc: Each person's tone by quarter. Emotional drift between them. When they diverged.
landing.seen4desc: An AI-generated interpretation — overview, dynamic, turning point, current state, reflection. Written to feel, not to report.
landing.coming1desc: The exact moment a conversation stopped being mutual. Not a score — a date.
landing.coming2desc: Who holds the group together. Who went quiet first. The social map of a conversation.
landing.coming3desc: Parsers already built. Full pipeline support coming in v2.
landing.closing: Some conversations end before the last message.
